content.title: Sports Complex Permitting & Scheduling
content.summary: The City of Arvada oversees the permitting and scheduling of organized sports activities on its public fields, which include several athletic complexes such as Harold D. Lutz Sports Complex and Stenger Sports Complex. Since 2022, the city has focused on enhancing access to outdoor recreational opportunities for its community, including both youth and adult sports. For field reservations and updates on field status, residents can visit the city's online reservation system or contact the city directly.
content.body:
![Sports Complex](/ImageRepository/Document?documentID=880 "Sports Complex")

The City of Arvada manages the permitting and scheduling of organized sports activities including soccer, lacrosse, rugby, baseball, softball, and more on the City's public fields. The City's athletic complexes include:

- Harold D. Lutz Sports Complex: 10664 W 58th Avenue
- Long Lake Regional Park: 17850 W 64th Avenue
- Stenger Sports Complex: 11200 W 58th Avenue
- Pioneer Park: 12100 W 82nd Avenue
- Foster Fields: 5300 Saulsbury Court
- Youth Memorial Sports Complex: 7619 Alkire Street

[Visit CivicRec](https://secure.rec1.com/CO/arvada-co/catalog), our field reservation system, to learn more and to submit a request.

## Athletic Field Status

[Visit the Athletic Field Status page](/888) for updates on weather-related field closures. The field status is updated daily by 1 p.m.

[![Click to view the Athletic Field Status page](/ImageRepository/Document?documentId=1423)](/888)

## Contact

If you have any questions or would like help reserving a field, please contact the City of Arvada at 720-898-7427 or contact the [Arvada Fields email](/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#ddbbb4b8b1b9ae9dbcafabbcb9bcf3b2afba).

## Project Background

Beginning in 2022, the City of Arvada began managing field programming and scheduling for the city's athletic fields and sports complexes. The City is focused on ensuring Arvada's parks and amenities evolve with our diverse, changing, and growing community. Our priority is to provides access to a variety of outdoor recreational opportunities and high-quality fields for the community, including youth and adult sports.
